+# Cover archival
+
+New archival uses four uncompressed zip files per 10,000 cover IDs (original,
+small, medium, large). A cover ID is exactly ten decimal digits, padded with
+leading zeroes. The first four digits are the million-cover `item_id`; the next
+two digits are the 10,000-cover `batch_id`. For cover `0008810000`, these are
+`0008` and `81`.
+
+Each size has a separate archive.org item. The item and local zip paths are:
+
+| Size | Item | Local zip path below `data_root` | Member name |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| Original | `covers_0008` | `items/covers_0008/covers_0008_81.zip` | `0008810000.jpg` |
+| Small | `s_covers_0008` | `items/s_covers_0008/s_covers_0008_81.zip` | `0008810000-S.jpg` |
+| Medium | `m_covers_0008` | `items/m_covers_0008/m_covers_0008_81.zip` | `0008810000-M.jpg` |
+| Large | `l_covers_0008` | `items/l_covers_0008/l_covers_0008_81.zip` | `0008810000-L.jpg` |
+
+Remote URLs use `https://archive.org/download/<item>/<zip>/<member>`.
+
+Run `archive.archive()` to stage up to 10,000 unarchived covers. It writes zip
+members, closes the zip files, then marks the covers `archived` and sets their
+filenames to local zip members. Covers with missing source images are marked
+`failed`. To upload and verify a batch, run
+`archive.Batch(8, 81).process_pending(upload=True, finalize=True)`. Finalization
+requires all four zip files to appear in their respective Internet Archive
+items. It then sets `uploaded=true`, stores the remote URLs in every filename
+field, and removes the local zip files. An unsuccessful upload leaves the staged
+zip files and records intact for retry. A shared lock under `items/` prevents
+simultaneous local archive and finalization jobs.
+
+Older tar archives and their index files remain readable for legacy covers.

@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+from datetime import datetime
+from zipfile import ZipFile
+
+import pytest
+
+from openlibrary.coverstore import archive, config, coverlib
+
+
+def test_cover_paths_and_url(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(config, 'data_root', str(tmp_path))
+    assert archive.Cover.id_to_item_and_batch_id(8810000) == ('0008', '81')
+    assert archive.Batch.get_relpath(8, 81, 'm') == (
+        'items/m_covers_0008/m_covers_0008_81.zip'
+    )
+    assert archive.Cover.get_cover_url(8810000, 'm', protocol='http') == (
+        'http://archive.org/download/m_covers_0008/'
+        'm_covers_0008_81.zip/0008810000-M.jpg'
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        archive.Cover.id_to_item_and_batch_id(10000000000)
+
+
+def test_zip_manager_retries_and_local_read(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(config, 'data_root', str(tmp_path))
+    source = tmp_path / 'source.jpg'
+    source.write_bytes(b'image')
+    name = '0008810000-S.jpg'
+    manager = archive.ZipManager()
+    member = manager.add_file(name, str(source), datetime(2020, 1, 1).timestamp())
+    manager.close()
+    manager = archive.ZipManager()
+    assert manager.add_file(name, str(source), datetime(2020, 1, 1).timestamp()) == member
+    manager.close()
+    path = archive.Batch.get_abspath(8, 81, 's')
+    with ZipFile(path) as zf:
+        assert zf.namelist() == [name]
+        assert zf.getinfo(name).compress_type == 0
+    assert archive.count_files_in_zip(path) == 1
+    assert coverlib.read_file(coverlib.find_image_path(member)) == b'image'
+
+
+def test_batch_finalizes_only_when_every_size_uploaded(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(config, 'data_root', str(tmp_path))
+    for size in archive.SIZES:
+        path = archive.Batch.get_abspath(8, 81, size)
+        from pathlib import Path
+        Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        Path(path).touch()
+    completed = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(archive.CoverDB, 'update_completed_batch',
+                        staticmethod(lambda item, batch, ext='jpg': completed.append((item, batch))))
+
+    class StubUploader:
+        available = set(archive.SIZES[:-1])
+
+        def is_uploaded(self, item, filename):
+            return item[0] in self.available or (item == 'covers_0008' and '' in self.available)
+
+    uploader = StubUploader()
+    batch = archive.Batch(8, 81)
+    assert batch.process_pending(finalize=True, uploader=uploader) is False
+    assert completed == []
+    uploader.available.add('l')
+    assert batch.process_pending(finalize=True, uploader=uploader) is True
+    assert completed == [('0008', '81')]
